title: The Harvest and the Winepress of Wrath
description: John sees one like the Son of Man sitting on a white cloud, wearing a golden crown and holding a sharp sickle. An angel from the temple calls out that the harvest time has come, and he reaps the earth. Then another angel comes out of the temple with a sharp sickle, and an angel from the altar commands him to gather the grapes from the vineyards of the earth. The grapes are thrown into the great winepress of God's wrath outside the city, and blood flows up to the horses' bridles for a distance of one thousand six hundred stadia.
